name: TwistingData.exists_le_weight_of_mem_deepForms
summary: Combinatorial Nullstellensatz with multiplicity over the field of rational functions K(x): substitute constants for the non-deep variables, give a deep variable v the cost 1/κ(v), κ(v) = P^{2r} or P, and use the points z(y), one for each y : I → residue field (I = Fin r × Fin (m+1), k = 2r + m), coming from the unipotent matrices 1 + Σ_t y_t E_{ρ(t),σ(t)}. Frobenius twists make each u^{κ(u)} the value of a cheap polynomial at these points; the image of F vanishes to order τ at each point, because the translate of F by the unipotent matrix is deep; and there are at least Π κ points. So the image of F has a monomial of cost ≥ τ, which comes from a monomial β of F with F(β) ≠ 0.

steps.claim: Choose J: for every letter i and natural b, J i b is a natural number j with j/2 = b and isEven(i − j).
steps.lean:
choose J hJ using fun i b ↦ show ∃ j : ℕ, j / 2 = b ∧ T.isEven (i - j) by by_contra! h; grind
    [T.isEven_succ (i - 2 * b - 1), sub_add_cancel, sub_sub, h (2 * b), h (2 * b + 1)]

steps.claim: For every i and b such a j exists among 2b and 2b + 1: otherwise isEven(i − 2b) and isEven(i − 2b − 1) would both be false, contradicting the alternation isEven_succ.
steps.lean:
show ∃ j : ℕ, j / 2 = b ∧ T.isEven (i - j) by by_contra! h; grind
    [T.isEven_succ (i - 2 * b - 1), sub_add_cancel, sub_sub, h (2 * b), h (2 * b + 1)]
steps.typed_fact: ∃ j : ℕ, j / 2 = b ∧ T.isEven (i - j)

steps.claim: Record 0 < p (named p), a Fintype structure on the finite residue field, the fact that p is prime, and write k = 2r + m (m, e) using hk.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨p, _, _, m, e⟩ := T.prime.pos, @ofFinite _ T.finite_residueField, Fact.mk T.prime, hk.dest

steps.claim: Let R = K[x_v : v ∈ Fin k × ℤ/N], x : R → Frac(R) the inclusion, and κ(v) = P^{deepIndicator(v)·e(v)}, e(v) = 2r if v.1 ≥ 2r and 1 otherwise; a variable v will cost 1/κ(v).

Let I = Fin r × Fin (m+1) (lexicographic order), ρ(t) = t.1 < r, σ(t) = t.1 + r if t.2 = 0 and k − t.2 otherwise (both ≥ r); c(v, t) = ±x_{rootVar σ(t) ρ(t) v.2} if v = rootVar ρ(t) σ(t) v.2 and 0 otherwise (sign + for even letters); a(i, y, t) = ι_i(lift of y_t) ∈ K ⊆ Frac(R) for y : I → residue field; and z(y, v) = Σ_t a(v.2, y, t)·c(v, t) ∈ Frac(R): z(y) is the point of the variables attached to y.

Claim hz: for every variable v, j ∈ ℕ and y: Σ_t c(v, t)^{P^j}·a(v.2 + j, y, t) = z(y, v)^{P^j}: the P^j-th power is additive in characteristic p, and a(s, y, t)^{P^j} = a(s + j, y, t) because ι_{s+j}(x) ≡ ι_s(x)^{P^j} mod p and p = 0 in K.
steps.lean:
have hz v (j : ℕ) y : x ∘ c v ^ T.P ^ j ⬝ᵥ a (v.2 + j) y = z y v ^ T.P ^ j := by
    erw [dotProduct_comm, ← pow_mul, sum_pow_char_pow]; simp [a, dotProduct, pow_mul, mul_pow,
      by simpa [CharP.cast_eq_zero] using T.frobenius_pow_congr j v.2]
steps.typed_fact: x ∘ c v ^ T.P ^ j ⬝ᵥ a (v.2 + j) y = z y v ^ T.P ^ j

steps.claim: Claim entry: for every letter i and every coefficient vector u indexed by I there is a polynomial g (over Frac(R)) all of whose monomials α have cost Σ_v α(v)/κ(v) < 1 and with g(z(y)) = Σ_t u_t a(i, y, t) for all y.
steps.lean:
have entry i u : ∃ g, (∀ α ∈ g.support, weight (κ · : _ → ℝ)⁻¹ α < 1) ∧
      ∀ y, eval (z y) g = u ⬝ᵥ a i y := by
    let j (t : I) := ite (t.2 = 0) 0 (J i t.1)
    let v t := T.rootVar (ρ t) (σ t) (i - j t)
    -- the system is invertible, as a specialisation makes it triangular
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (x.mapMatrix (of fun t ↦ c (v t) ^ T.P ^ j t)).vecMul_surjective_iff_isUnit.2
      (by clear * - p hJ hN
          simp [↓isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, ↓← x.map_det, x, R]
          apply ne_of_apply_ne (eval fun v ↦ 0 ^ ((i - v.2).val / 2 - v.1))
          rw [RingHom.map_det, det_of_isUpperTriangular fun _ _ ↦ ?_ ∘ Prod.lex_def.1] <;> simp [c,
            v, rootVar, univ.prod_eq_zero_iff, apply_ite (eval _),
            @Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (j _) N (by grind)] <;> grind [pow_eq_zero_iff']) u
    use ∑ t, w t • X (v t) ^ T.P ^ j t, fun α h ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ by
      simpa [← hz, v, Matrix.map] using! dotProduct_mulVec ..
    obtain ⟨t, rfl, -⟩ := by simpa [coeff_X_pow] using support_sum h
    simp [weight_single, field, κ, -mul_ite]; clear * - hJ; gcongr <;> grind [rootVar,
      deepIndicator, one_lt_P]
steps.typed_fact:
∃ g, (∀ α ∈ g.support, weight (κ · : _ → ℝ)⁻¹ α < 1) ∧
      ∀ y, eval (z y) g = u ⬝ᵥ a i y

steps.claim: Let j(t) = 0 if t.2 = 0 and J i t.1 otherwise, and v(t) = rootVar ρ(t) σ(t) (i − j(t)).
steps.lean:
let j (t : I) := ite (t.2 = 0) 0 (J i t.1)
    let v t := T.rootVar (ρ t) (σ t) (i - j t)

steps.claim: The I×I matrix (c(v(t), t')^{P^{j(t)}})_{t,t'} over Frac(R) is invertible, so u = w·(that matrix) for some vector w: its determinant is nonzero because evaluating at the point sending v to 0^{((i − v.2) mod N)/2 − v.1} makes the matrix upper triangular (for the lexicographic order of I) with nonzero diagonal (uses 2r < N and the choice of J).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (x.mapMatrix (of fun t ↦ c (v t) ^ T.P ^ j t)).vecMul_surjective_iff_isUnit.2
      (by clear * - p hJ hN
          simp [↓isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, ↓← x.map_det, x, R]
          apply ne_of_apply_ne (eval fun v ↦ 0 ^ ((i - v.2).val / 2 - v.1))
          rw [RingHom.map_det, det_of_isUpperTriangular fun _ _ ↦ ?_ ∘ Prod.lex_def.1] <;> simp [c,
            v, rootVar, univ.prod_eq_zero_iff, apply_ite (eval _),
            @Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (j _) N (by grind)] <;> grind [pow_eq_zero_iff']) u

steps.claim: Take g = Σ_t w_t·x_{v(t)}^{P^{j(t)}}; its value at z(y) is Σ_t u_t a(i, y, t) by hz and dotProduct_mulVec.
steps.lean:
use ∑ t, w t • X (v t) ^ T.P ^ j t, fun α h ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ by
      simpa [← hz, v, Matrix.map] using! dotProduct_mulVec ..

steps.claim: A monomial α in the support of g is x_{v(t)}^{P^{j(t)}} for some t.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨t, rfl, -⟩ := by simpa [coeff_X_pow] using support_sum h

steps.claim: Its cost P^{j(t)}/κ(v(t)) is < 1: by the choice of J the variable v(t) is deep with κ(v(t)) = P^{e} where e > j(t) (P > 1).
steps.lean:
simp [weight_single, field, κ, -mul_ite]; clear * - hJ; gcongr <;> grind [rootVar,
      deepIndicator, one_lt_P]

steps.claim: Let ι : R → Frac(R)[x] be the substitution that keeps the deep variables and replaces each non-deep variable x_v by the constant x(x_v).
steps.lean: let ι := eval₂Hom (C.comp (x.comp C)) fun v ↦ ite (T.deepIndicator r v = 0) (C (x (X v))) (X v)

Two of its hypotheses remain as goals: the number of points, and the vanishing.

    (entry 0 (Pi.single t 1)).elim fun _ hf ↦ (y t).out_eq ▸ (y' t).out_eq ▸ Ideal.Quotient.eq.2
    (mt (·.map (T.ι 0)) (by simpa [← h, hf, a, x, R] using hf.2 y'))) ?_ (fun _ ↦ by simp only [κ,
    ← hz, entry]) τ (ι (polyOfCoeffs F)) (fun h ↦
    F0 (by ext β; simpa [polyOfCoeffs, coeff_sum] using congrArg (·.coeff (exponentOf β)) (by
           simpa [h, x] using congr(($(show x = .comp (eval (x ∘ X)) ι by
           ext <;> simp [ι, apply_ite])) (polyOfCoeffs F)) : polyOfCoeffs F = 0))) fun y ↦ ?_

steps.lean:
(fun y y' h ↦ funext fun t ↦
    (entry 0 (Pi.single t 1)).elim fun _ hf ↦ (y t).out_eq ▸ (y' t).out_eq ▸ Ideal.Quotient.eq.2
    (mt (·.map (T.ι 0)) (by simpa [← h, hf, a, x, R] using hf.2 y')))

steps.claim: The count of points is left as a goal (?_); each u^{κ(u)} agrees at the points with a polynomial of cost < 1, by entry combined with hz.
steps.lean:
?_ (fun _ ↦ by simp only [κ,
    ← hz, entry])

           simpa [h, x] using congr(($(

steps.claim: x = (evaluation at the variables x(x_v)) ∘ ι, an identity of ring homomorphisms R → Frac(R), checked on constants and variables.
steps.lean:
show x = .comp (eval (x ∘ X)) ι by
           ext <;> simp [ι, apply_ite])) (polyOfCoeffs F)) : polyOfCoeffs F = 0)))

steps.claim: The vanishing of f to order τ at each z(y) is left as a goal.
steps.lean: fun y ↦ ?_

steps.claim: Expand the coefficient of α in ι(polyOfCoeffs F) as a sum over β of F(β) times products of constants: only β whose deep part is α contribute.
steps.lean:
simp [polyOfCoeffs, coeff_sum, ι, prod_fintype, prod_ite, ← map_pow, ← map_prod,
    coeff_prod_X_pow] at h

steps.claim: As the sum is nonzero, some β with deep part α has F(β) ≠ 0.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨β, rfl, h, -⟩ := by simpa [x] using exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h

steps.claim: This β works: its weight Σ β_s(b)·deepIndicator/P^{e(b)} equals the cost of α, which is ≥ τ.
steps.lean: use β, h, H.trans (by simp [weight_eq_sum, κ, deepIndicator]; bound)

steps.claim: The number of points: there are (P^N)^{|I|} = (P^N)^{r(m+1)} choices of y (card_residueField), and Π_v κ(v) = P^{Σ_v deepIndicator(v)e(v)} = P^{(N/2)(2r + 2rm)} ≤ P^{N r (m+1)}, using that each b is deep for N/2 letters (sum_deepIndicator).
steps.lean:
subst e
  grw [card_fun, card_eq_nat_card, T.card_residueField, ← pow_mul, ← N.div_mul_le_self 2,
    prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, pow_le_pow_right₀] <;> simp [I, ↓sum_prod_type, ← univ.sum_mul,
    sum_deepIndicator, Fin.sum_univ_add, ← Nat.not_lt, -not_lt] <;> lia

steps.claim: For the vanishing at z(y): let A = Σ_t y_t·E_{ρ(t),σ(t)} (lifted entries; A² = 0 as ρ(t) < r ≤ σ(t')) and g = 1 + A ∈ GL_k(W), with inverse 1 − A.
steps.lean:
let A := ∑ t, Matrix.single (ρ t) (σ t) (y t).out
  let g : GL _ W := by use 1 + A, 1 + -A <;> simp (disch := lia) [A, univ.sum_mul_sum]

steps.claim: Write F = ρ(g⁻¹)ρ(g)F and pass to polynomials: polyOfCoeffs F = polyAction g⁻¹ (polyOfCoeffs(ρ(g)F)).
steps.lean:
rw [show F = T.letterRep n g⁻¹ *ᵥ T.letterRep n g *ᵥ F by simp [← map_mul],
    ← polyAction_polyOfCoeffs]

steps.claim: F = ρ(g⁻¹)·(ρ(g)·F), as ρ is multiplicative and ρ(1) = 1.
steps.lean:
show F = T.letterRep n g⁻¹ *ᵥ T.letterRep n g *ᵥ F by simp [← map_mul],
    ← polyAction_polyOfCoeffs]
steps.typed_fact: F = T.letterRep n g⁻¹ *ᵥ T.letterRep n g *ᵥ F

steps.lean: simp [polyOfCoeffs, monomial_eq]

steps.claim: It suffices that each term lies in the τ-th power of the vanishing ideal: a term with depth(β) < τ is 0 (hF at g: (ρ(g)F)_β = 0), and for depth(β) ≥ τ it suffices that the image of the product of the deep variables of x^β (depth(β) of them) lies in the depth(β)-th power, which is contained in the τ-th.
steps.lean:
refine sum_mem fun β _ ↦ (le_or_gt ..).elim
    (pow_le_pow_right · (mul_mem_left _ _ ?_)) (hF g nofun β · ▸ by simp)

steps.claim: Write the deep part of x^β as Π_v (image of x_v)^{β(v)·deepIndicator(v)}.
steps.lean: simp [depth, weight_eq_sum, ← prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, pow_mul']

steps.claim: It suffices that the image under ι∘polyAction(g⁻¹) of each deep variable lies in the vanishing ideal of the point z(y).
steps.lean: refine prod_mem_prod fun v _ ↦ pow_mem_pow ?_ _

steps.claim: Case analysis on the parity of the letter of v and on r ≤ v.1: g⁻¹ = 1 − A sends a deep variable v to x_v minus a combination whose value at z(y) is z(y, v) (the entries of A at (ρ(t), σ(t)) are the y_t), so the image vanishes at z(y).
steps.lean:
by_cases T.isEven v.2 <;> by_cases r ≤ v.1 <;> simp [polyAction_X, letterMatrix_apply, g, A, c,
    rootVar, ι, z, a, add_mul, univ.sum_mul, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.single, ite_and,
    @Finset.sum_comm I, deepIndicator, *, dotProduct,
    apply_ite (DFunLike.coe _), -coe_eval₂Hom, show ∀ t, ¬r ≤ ρ t ∧ r ≤ σ t by lia, Prod.ext_iff]

steps.lean: show ∀ t, ¬r ≤ ρ t ∧ r ≤ σ t by lia, Prod.ext_iff]
